entry.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI isn't just the biggest GTA game to date; it's also the most romantic. Though the series is well known for its sordid assortment of criminal leads, GTA VI switches things up by starring a pair of thieves who also happen to fall in love after meeting while stealing a car. It's still an open-world action game full of chaos and mayhem. But many players will also be attempting to nurture the budding relationship in between heists. The sprawling game is designed to support both audiences.

entry.content:
Robert Pattinson's casting as James Bond made enough sense given his recent work with director Denis Villeneuve, who's making the franchise's next film over at Amazon. But it turns out that Amazon founder Jeff Bezos played a significant role in making the final decision, too.

During Semafor's Silicon Valley and the World conference today, Bezos said that he was "heavily involved" in the process of casting the newest 007:

We ran a really tight process and we made the final decision on Friday. There was a big group initially, and we down-selected to five finalists. Then we did real old-fashioned screen tests of those five finalists, and it …
